CVE-2006-2492.n: Microsoft Word Malformed Object Pointer Vulnerability
CVE-2006-2492.d: Microsoft Word and Microsoft Works Suites contain a malformed object pointer which allows attackers to execute code.

CVE-2006-1547.d: ActionForm in Apache Struts versions before 1.2.9 with BeanUtils 1.7 contains a vulnerability that allows for denial-of-service (DoS).
